title: Bewa Shabbar Ki Ro Kar Pukari Mere Bachchay Ki Aati Hai Mehndi
body:
Loag Karte Hain Kyun Aaho Zaari
Mere Bachchay Ki Aati Hai Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Koyi Dulha Ki Phupiyon Ko Laao
Unki Choti Chachi Ko Bulao
Dair Hoti Hai Jald Aao Wari
Mere Bachchay Ki Aati Hai Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaake Kehdo Ye Shah-E-Zaman Say
Koyi Sughra Ko Laae Watan Say
Jaaein Akbar Maangaye Sawaari
Mere Bachchay Ki Aati Hai Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaake Sher-e-Khuda Ke Nawasein
Kehde Dulha Ke Chote Chacha Say
Ghar Mein Shaadi Ki Rasme Hai Jaari
Mere Bachchay Ki Aati Hai Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Sunti Ho Fatima Ki Khunzaadi
Ghar Mein Do Bhaiyon Ke Hai Shaadi
Aaj Jaagi Hai Kismat Tumhari
Mere Bachchay Ki Aati Hai Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Koyi Qabre Hassan Par Ye Kehna
Dekto Jaaein Bete Ka Sehra
Un Ki Furqat Mein Aansoon Hai Jaari
Mere Bachchay Ki Aati Hai Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri Baali Sakina Kahan Ho
Kyun Nigahon Se Ab Tak Nihaa Ho
Neig Lejaoo Bano Ki Pyaari
Mere Bachchay Ki Aati Hai Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Wazir Ek Mehshar Bapa Tha
Sune Wala Har Ek Ro Raha Tha
Maa Jo Kehti Thi Ba Aaho Zaari
Mere Bachchay Ki Aati Hai Mehndi
